integrity: The corrected threshold is reconstructed from the printed infected subsystem using the standard next-generation decomposition. A rank-one calculation gives the exact spectral radius, and an exact rational two-strain counterexample produces a positive Jacobian eigenvalue while the published threshold is below one. The bundled checker replays that certificate without external dependencies.
scientific_limitations: The correction applies to the pooled exposed compartment in the printed equations; a different model with separate strain-specific exposed compartments requires a separate next-generation calculation.
Only the disease-free invasion threshold is corrected; endemic-equilibrium and optimal-control claims are not reassessed.
The exact two-strain counterexample is a mathematical certificate rather than a calibrated epidemiological parameter set.
title: A shared exposed class makes the multi-strain threshold additive
